summary: Phase 6 / S4 Core foundation for NFS backup repositories, stopped full backup publication and restore-as-new from local copies.

guide.reason: This slice delivers Core APIs and durable host state only. Operator UI workflows and guide walkthroughs belong to the Controller/UI lane.

api.reason: Adds host-local backup repository, backup-now, restore-as-new, catalog and run routes, ManagedState inventory flags, and the stopped-backup development contract in docs/API.md and local-openapi.json.

roadmap.reason: S4 Core foundation only; Phase 6 gate and public roadmap status remain open until later slices close.

state.reason: Pool backup destinations, recovery points and run history are Core-owned and must survive Controller replacement without Controller database state.
